title: HostLab provider selection for MeguvizDexDash
description: Which engine HostLab's `auto` work goes to, and how the MeguvizDexDash engine is used. The only thing that routes work to the new engine is native_engine; its value `dexsql` is the rollback value and the default. A request that names `sqlite` or `dexsql` is never moved by this file. provider.py parse_config enforces exactly this schema; the tests run both over the same documents.

native_engine.description: The engine for work that HostLab's planner would give to DexSQL when the request says `auto`. `dexsql` restores the original backend and switches the new one off: a request that names meguvizdexdash is then refused, not served by another backend.

manifest.description: The pinned engine manifest (install_meguvizdexdash.py pin). null: HOSTLAB_MEGUVIZDEXDASH_MANIFEST, else vendor/meguvizdexdash/manifest.json.

dialect.description: The engine's SQL dialect for HostLab's `dexsql` queries. The engine must list it with the hostlab-contract-relations feature.

profile.description: The profile that must be listed by the engine's capabilities and that reports name.

profile_policy.description: require_admitted: a profile that is not admitted makes the engine unavailable. allow_unadmitted: use it, and every report still says admitted=false.

cache_dir.description: Base of MDD_CACHE_DIR, relative to HostLab's state directory. null: <state>/mdd-engine/cache. A path that is, contains or lies inside any DexSQL or HostLab cache, report or completion directory is refused.

fallback.description: Explicit, recorded fallback of tasks that `auto` gave the engine, and only for these three codes. No other code can be listed. A request with negotiation.fallback=forbid, or one that names the engine, never falls back.
